title: asb image (~/.config/asb/images/NAME/image.yaml)
description: Optional settings for the image whose directory holds this file. The directory is the build context unless `context` is set.

description.description: What the image is for, shown by `asb image ls`.

context.description: Build context directory, if not this directory: absolute, starting with ~/, or relative to this directory.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile, relative to the context (default: Dockerfile).

args.description: Build args, in addition to USERNAME, UID, and GID.
